links.outcome: Local retrospective accuracy of baseline CDST for clinical remission at weeks 26 and 52
links.effect: AUCs for clinical remission were 0.57 (week 26) and 0.64 (week 52); 0.52 (w26) and 0.64 (w52) for corticosteroid-free clinical remission; CDST showed poor diagnostic accuracy.
links.quote: AUCs for clinical remission were 0.57 (week 26) and 0.64 (week 52), 0.52 (w26) and 0.64 (w52) for corticosteroid-free clinical remission.

screen.reason: This study is an external validation of an existing predictive clinical decision support tool (CDST) in a real-world retrospective cohort, assessing its predictive performance without testing a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
